newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil cuts Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil cuts Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$13.00/cubic metre or C$2.07/barrel, effective immediately.
The new prices were listed as follows:
Edmonton light sweet C$180.00/cubic metre, or C$28.61/barrel
Cromer light sour C$173.00/cubic metre, or C$27.50/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$140.00/cubic metre, or C$22.26/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$148.00/cubic metre, or C$23.53/barrel
